entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...I can't believe this.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The public believes in the justice of the[n]Phantom Thieves. They have no interest[n]in that principal.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm experiencing equal levels of[n]frustration. My comments on TV[n]turned everyone against me.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Then again, I won't allow mere criticism[n]to break my spirit so easily.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: We won't keep letting ourselves be[n]defeated either.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: My suspicion after the hacker's case[n]last month is now conviction, thanks to[n]the principal's death.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The mental shutdown cases and the[n]psychotic breakdowns are surely the[n]Phantom Thieves' doing.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I remember the data you showed me[n]about Okumura Foods. Is that the basis[n]for these beliefs?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: There have been frequent occurrences[n]of mental shutdowns surrounding[n]Okumura recently.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: If only there was a clear connection[n]between him and the Phantom Thieves...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Well, it would be problematic if there[n]wasn't one.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So you're jumping the gun here.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You really told a man you would terminate[n]his parental authority based purely on[n]your speculation?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm surprised you would say such a thing[n]to the owner of a café you frequent...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It's all for the sake of the case.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You may have the backing of the SIU's[n]director... but you've been far too[n]aggressive, Sae-san.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You're trespassing into police territory.[n]Don't say nobody warned you if this[n]becomes an issue later.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: My superiors told me the same thing.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We first need to know what methods[n]the Phantom Thieves are using.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The police can't make a move unless[n]that becomes apparent, after all.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: This opponent can't be caught by[n]following the rules. What need is there[n]to stick to formalities?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So you wish to ignore protocol in order[n]to reform society?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I hope you realize that's no different than[n]what the Phantom Thieves are doing.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It's a shame, especially since we both[n]want to capture the culprit behind the[n]psychotic breakdowns...
